findings.source: DssVest.sol:263-271 accrued(), 294-296 unpaid() inlined into _yank (351-367) and _vest
findings.issue: Checks and arms decided by dominating conditions are kept: in _yank's last arm t < clf, t >= bgn and t < old fin are already known, and in every inlined accrued() the two sub-underflow checks and the assert follow from bgn <= t < fin. About 42 lines, 3 dead arms per yank.
findings.rule: Propagate range facts from dominating branch conditions, and treat x and uint48(x) as equal after a passed require x == uint48(x); then fold a - b > a to false when b <= a is known, a != b to true when b < a is known (also through a transitive chain b <= t < a), and drop arms whose condition is decided.

findings.issue: The same pure value min(_20, _maxAmt) is printed 6 times (and SafeMath.add(...) twice in one line) instead of being bound once as the source's amt.
findings.rule: Bind a pure subexpression that is used more than once to a fresh local at its first use.

notes: No loops in the source or the text. All 31 ABI functions reviewed; TWENTY_YEARS, vat, join, daiJoin, chainlog are consts. The tau-zero require of create() is folded with the next division into a contract-specific helper 'SafeMath.div(a, b): if b <= 0: revert with DssVest/tau-zero' - exact at its single use (same order). The printed helper 'SafeMath.mul(a, b): if a * b / a != b: revert' is exact only for a != 0; both uses have a = 10^27, so the text is exact here. awards mapping named bgn after the bgn(uint256) getter though awards(uint256) returns the whole struct (P13). Packed field writes of create/vest use distributed shifts ((_bgn << 208) + (_eta << 208), (_19 << 128) + (rxd << 128)) - exact after the toUint48/toUint128 checks (P15). id = ++ids is printed as _2 = ids; ids++ and _2 + 1 four times. yank uses the saved old fin (_19) in the inlined unpaid, as the source's memory copy does - correct. Order of the sub checks in accrued (fin - bgn before t - bgn) is solc's right-operand-first evaluation - faithful.
summary: Compact, faithful text with no semantic discrepancy found; the noise is in the inlined accrued/unpaid formula (dominated checks kept, P11; distributed product, P9), the awards mapping named after the bgn getter (P13), and solc immutables read as 0 (artifact).
